setup: dev_v1.1 first 4 images, legacy anonymization inversion, noise_level 200, batch 1
contention_warning: GPU shared during measurement with an ollama runner (6.3 GB) and an auditor script (audit/e2_wht_smoke.py); eager single-process ran at ~37-40 ms/step vs 15.5 ms/step measured exclusively in AF021_ANON_BENCH. Ratios are indicative only; re-measure on an exclusive GPU before relying on them.
cuda_graph_note: graph mode requires monkey-patching guided_diffusion.unet_v1.timestep_embedding so the CPU-computed freqs are cached on device (same CPU expression as the predecessor); past/ is not modified
concurrency_timing_note: concurrent wall_seconds were measured by the shell and include process start-up and model loading; eager_single wall_seconds is measured inside the process after loading, so concurrency throughput ratios are conservative
